scene nightsky
I’ve been thinking a lot lately about what I’d say to Maki if I ever see her again.

Unfortunately, pretty much any progress I’ve made on that front has gone out the window considering that she is now apparently a part of something far more complicated than who I put my penis inside of.
And I trust Makoto to handle that, sure.
I just don’t think that any amount of handling will be able to convince Maki at all. So it’s mostly just a matter of time now and that makes things come full circle and get all confusing again.
Regardless, I’m outside of the porn shop right now and hoping that Maki will come outside and accidentally encounter me.
I’m not really sure what I’ll do if she does. But it’s enough to make me feel as if I’m contributing and that’s really all life is about sometimes.

Occasionally, you help things progress. Occasionally, you slow them down. And occasionally, you get caught sleeping with your friend’s teenage daughter and then have to explain to her that it’s okay because time is infinite and she is immortal.
Whatever the case, I need to-
Hold on a second. I need to take this.
: Hello?
: Sensei, come quick! We have another code red! And this time, it’s the one you mentioned yesterday!
: Why do we have multiple code reds? There are so many other colors.
: I’ll tell you after you help me get out of this cage.

: It’s supposed to be a wall. A cage is a different, more realistic fetish where you get to look at me while I’m having sex with you instead of just wondering who’s using your lower half for their own personal gain.
: Help. The cage is suddenly a wall. Half of my body is so vulnerable right now. I sure hope no one uses it for their own personal gain.
: Say no more. I’m on the way. Where are-
: My dorm! Be here in exactly twenty minutes. Thanks! Bye!
: Okay, see- oh. Oh, okay.
scene black
Now, do I think Makoto is actually trapped in a wall? No. In fact, I’ve never really understood how that became a thing at all. I just like that it did.
And because I like that it did, I’m willing to give this a shot. I mean, what’s the worst that could possibly happen by just heading over to her dorm for the millionth time?
scene makotopowerpoint1
Oh.
Okay. Well, yeah. This is actually pretty bad.
: What the fuck are you doing here?...Did you put her up to this?

: Hi, Sensei. Could you go ahead and take a seat? I wasn’t really sure how to properly articulate and explain our current situation, so I did what I always do when I’m overwhelmed and made a PowerPoint about it.
: This is an evil trick, Makoto. And not even remotely close to the first code red. Very close to the second, though, I will admit.
: Is this a joke to you two? Who else is in on it?
: Are Sara and Haruka about to walk through the door next? Because they also had no trouble rallying against me the last time I had to be the only sane person in the room.
scene makotopowerpoint2
: That’s a question for Makoto, not me. I’m only here because I was duped. Same as you, most likely.

: No, Akira. I came here to bring her back because I’m much more comfortable with my daughter staying at my house where I can be sure she isn’t fucking her teacher. This is a thing normal people care about.

: I figured this would happen when I didn’t go home after my appointment today. So I threw this all together in the time between those two things and manufactured an impromptu family meeting of sorts.
scene makotopowerpoint3
: He is not family, Makoto. We are family. Miku is family. And if he were family, it would somehow make this even more terrible since incest is only good in porn.
: Let the record show that I do agree that this is terrible and that I’m only kind of not the target audience for this presentation as well. Just more willing to be convinced.
scene makotopowerpoint4
: You know, you could just leave her alone and not ruin her fucking life. That’s always an option too, you sick, disgusting piece of shit.
: You can’t say I didn’t try to warn you, Maki.
scene makotopowerpoint5
: Warn me?! You thinking warning me makes this any less-
scene makotopowerpoint6

: Hi. Presenter here. Loving the enthusiasm so far but, if it’s not a problem, I’d like to get the ball rolling so this isn’t just an open discussion about what I should be allowed to do with my body. Thanks.
: Your body belongs to me until you’re in college and that is final.
: Which is unreasonable for a number of reasons that I hope to shine a light on with my presentation today. So I ask that you remain calm and-
: Don’t you dare fucking bring that chair closer to me, Akira!
: And treat each other with the same respect that you wish to be treated with. Thank you.
scene makotopowerpoint7
: There’s a glare on the screen when I sit further away. I’m just trying to see the PowerPoint.
: Oh, you mean the PowerPoint about why it’s okay for you to fuck my daughter? That PowerPoint? You’re excited for that?
: I wouldn’t say I’m excited. Just curious about how Makoto is going to try and dig herself out of the colossal hole she created by blatantly confessing everything to you.
: At least she was brave enough to do that instead of spouting a bunch of vague nonsense and getting me to do the heavy lifting like a certain someone.
: You are still mad and that is fair. I am not a good person.
: I hope you get hit by a plane.
scene makotopowerpoint8
: Cool! So, on that note, I guess I’ll begin.
scene makotopowerpoint9

: From an outsider’s perspective, I’m sure this whole thing seems pretty cut and dry. High school student. Predatory teacher. It’s a tale as old as time and one that we’ve all seen on the news time and time again.
: The reason for this, however, is that it’s easy to sensationalize because society has instilled within us a set of morals that we can not bend without being labeled as insane or immoral.

: What society fails to understand, though, is that each and every one of us is guided by our own moral code shaped by personal experiences and perception and that adhering to a set of rules forced upon us by those who believe they know what’s best for us deprives us of the freedom we need to live happily.
: Oh, good. We’re already at the part where you make me feel stupid and insignificant because of how smart and articulate you are. It can only get better from here, can’t it?
scene makotopowerpoint10
: Context is key, Mom. And sometimes, things that appear to be wrong from one person’s point of view only appear that way at all because they lack a proper view of the big picture.

: For example, if one of Dad’s friends saw you getting railed at a bar by some random guy without knowing about your “open relationship,” they’d have assumed you were a cheating whore. But you’re not.
: You’re just a regular one.
: Okay. Maybe don’t insult her like that, Makoto. You’re lacking context too, aren’t you?
scene makotopowerpoint11
: That’s absolutely correct, Sensei. Because, as the projector shows, expectations rarely fit reality. Which means that what we see is what we get, but it isn’t what we have.
scene makotopowerpoint12
: Now, we’re all in agreement that sex is awesome. Right? It’s humanity’s pastime. And it used to be free until religion reshaped what is now the modern day landscape of interpersonal intimacy.
: Even that varies from culture to culture, though. And sometimes on a much smaller scale than you’d imagine.

: In Japan alone, prefectures have never been on the same page when it comes to taking action on this. Which is why even the national age of consent is contested in some municipalities that see it as too low.

: The key argument you’ll hear when this is brought up most of the time is that anyone under that age is not mentally mature enough to make decisions that, sometimes consequently, result in things like teenage pregnancy or, in Miku’s case, physical harm.
: But I ask you this — am I among those you’d deem mentally immature?
: Yes. Yes, Makoto. You are.
: Then I will counter with the fact that so is Sensei and that none of this actually matters anyway because of slide two.
scene makotopowerpoint13
: Oh my fucking-

: The world is broken, everything is fucked, and you are quite literally asking me to do the impossible by waiting to be in college before I have sex with my teacher when I can never actually grow up.
: I’m getting you a new psychiatrist.
scene makotopowerpoint14

: I know how it sounds, okay?! I didn’t believe it either until I had no choice but to believe it. And now I have no idea how old I even am because this has been going on for an indeterminate amount of time!
: Even then, though, I’ve been conscious of it long enough that I likely would be in college by now if time did progress!

: Which means I have mentally matured to the point where I’d legally be allowed to make decisions like this without your parental input. Which is great, because sex could be important to saving us all!
: From what?!
: I don’t really know! We haven’t figured that part out yet!
scene makotopowerpoint15
: What the fuck have you done to my daughter, Akira? What pretentious bullshit have you fed her that has turned her from a brilliant little girl into a fucking conspiracy theorist?
: I know how it sounds, but she’s right. We are caught in a timeloop. And you’re somehow now in on it and breaking a long-standing rule of only younger girls gaining such awareness.

: Oh, how convenient. I find out you’re fucking my daughter and I’m now special and gifted enough to be sucked into your little sex cult where you’ve convinced a bunch of teenagers you’re God. I can’t wait.
: I’m no god, Maki. I’m just confused and lost and want to get out of this. And so does Makoto. Kind of.
scene makotopowerpoint16
: Kind of?
scene makotopowerpoint17
: Believe it or not, I’m happier here. I don’t have to worry about the pressure of getting into a prestigious college or what I’ll do when I grow up.

: I can just live my life the way I want. And sometimes that includes reading or studying, sure. But it also includes a ton of recreational sex because, to hearken back to an earlier slide, it’s awesome and fun.

: And if all of this is part of some cycle, perhaps one visually represented in a PowerPoint right now, forced abstinence will do nothing but subject me to an eternity of misery that, let’s face it, I’d absolutely go over your head to break out of anyway.
: Yes, you’ve made that very apparent. But I’m not going to believe that this is all part of some time-conspiracy thing just because the two of you put a little slide-show together.
: You’ve been manipulated by a man you admire, Makoto. And Akira has poisoned your mind into something fragile enough to believe something so incredibly fucking stupid.
: Mom, let’s be real. Do you really think Sensei would be able to convince me about this? I’m way smarter than him and we all know it. Correct?
: She’s right. If anything, Makoto would be the one convincing me that this is the fate we’ve fallen into.
: Oh, great. Then she has a degenerative brain disease and it is progressing so quickly that her grip on reality is now all but gone. How convenient. Again.

: Now, I obviously knew you wouldn’t believe any of this. Which is why I’ve also enlisted the help of an uninvolved third and fourth party who may now enter the room with their respective testimonials. Girls!
scene black
scene makotopowerpoint18
: Hi, Mrs. Miyamura. Hi, Sensei.
: Sup, porn lady. Long time, no see.
: Wha...so you two are in on this too? Why?...
: What do you get out of going along with something so insane? Is he paying you?
scene makotopowerpoint19
: Nope! I’m rich. Sensei would never be able to afford me if I didn’t throw myself at him free of charge.
: Makoto’s payin’ me in food to show up for this shit but, other than that, I ain’t gotten anything.
: Ayane, Yumi — in your own words, could you please explain the nature of our universe to my mother? In simple terms though, please.
: Well, basically, we’re trapped in a never-ending year of high-school where only a select few can actually talk about it without glitching out.

: And once every few months, the sky gets all weird and we’re transported to a different part of the year where pretty much everybody else has no idea all that crazy shit even happened in the first place.
: You’re the first adult we’ve ever had apart from Sensei! And with Nodoka and Uta in the loop now too, our numbers are really growing all of a sudden.
: Then...have you two...also been groomed by this guy?
scene makotopowerpoint20
: She has. I haven’t.
: I like to think that I’m the one who groomed him.
: You’re kidding...it’s gone this far?...It’s this normal now?
: If you have any questions, I can leave the room with Sensei and you can cross-reference our answers once we return to further prove that we’re not making this up.
: The world really is broken. And I would like to use that as an excuse to continue living life the way I want to live without having to argue about it every day.
scene makotopowerpoint21
: Makoto’s been really helpful, Mrs. Miyamura. Like, I like to think that I’m the leader of the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad, but she’s got a pretty equal hold of the reins at this point.

: Been a lot more bearable ever since all this shit started too. Used to just be the annoying girl who always tried to make me do my homework and shit and I actually don’t hate her now. So that’s cool.
: And you don’t...find it odd that...she and Akira...that you and Akira...
: I am biased and have been in love with Sensei since before all this timeloop stuff started, so I’m not the right person to ask.
: And I do think it’s creepy as shit, so I ain’t the person to ask either.
: I didn’t bring them here to weigh in on that part. Their presence was mostly just to confirm the whole “broken world” aspect.
: Well, they’ve done their part and I’d like them to leave now.
scene makotopowerpoint22
: When do I get my food?
: Come on, Yumi. Let’s let Makoto wrap her PowerPoint up and I’ll order us a pizza.
scene black
: Bet. I get my own, right? Cause I ain’t gonna share when you probably want something gay like olives or some shit.
: You can have ten pizzas thanks to my never-ending quest to spite my dad. And yes, I am going to get olives and there is nothing you can do to stop me.
scene makotopowerpoint23
: So, to recap what we’ve learned today — the world is broken. But even if it wasn’t, there would still be a plethora of reasons for you to accept my relationship with Sensei.
: That said, I do not wish to ask for your blessing. Just that you accept the perplexing state of the universe and stop blaming yourself for all of the things we-
: I am finding you a new psychiatrist.
scene makotopowerpoint24
: Keep your hands off my fucking daughter.
scene makotopowerpoint25
scene makotopowerpoint26
: Well, that went about as well as I expected it to.
: You mean horrible?
scene makotopowerpoint27
: I wouldn’t say horrible. I mean, she did leave us together in a room that she knows we’re probably going to have more sex in. So that’s a plus.
: It was a good idea getting Yumi and Ayane to testify. But I imagine Maki probably just thinks they’re in on the plot to bomb her thoughts now too.
scene makotopowerpoint28
: Yes, and I imagine she’ll continue to think that way until she’s forced to believe like I was.
: Either that or she does get reset and I can just hope and pray that everything I confessed to her is subsequently purged from her mind.
: How are you feeling about all of this?
: What, like, having her know about us? Or having her in on the loops?
: Actually, I guess the intent behind the question doesn’t really matter when I hate both of those things.
: You hate having her aware? Why?

: Because it’s like she’s chaperoning a field trip I didn’t invite her to. I don’t want my mom in on the world where I get to have unlimited sex with my teacher and skip doing my homework some nights.
: You’re not skipping your homework, Makoto. I don’t believe that for one second.
scene makotopowerpoint29
: But I could. And that’s really what matters at the end of the day.
: So, what now? We just...sit around and wait for something traumatizing to happen to her?
: I guess. Do you think she’ll see Big Boi?
scene black
: Ahh, forget it. Just take my clothes off and tell me you liked my PowerPoint.
: That’s the single most Makoto thing you’ve ever said to me.
: I know. But where do you think you’re-
: Locking the door for plausible deniability if Maki forgot something and tries to come back in.
: I’ve never been more attracted to you in my life.
Do I think tonight’s presentation worked?
No.
But do I think that it might in time?
Yes.
Because we have plenty of it here — which gives the cracks forming in Maki’s psyche plenty of time to splinter and ultimately force her to shatter when her frame can no longer bear them.
And when that happens, Makoto and I will be there to pick up the pieces.
Well, I’ll be there to pick up the pieces. Makoto will be there to say, “I told you so.”
But just when Maki hits her lowest, I’ll have a dustpan waiting to scoop her back up — with an empty spot in my pocket reserved just for her.
In time, I’ll mix her with the rest.
And with those fragments, I will make something beautiful.
A vase.
A vessel to hold my flowers.
Every day, they grow some more.
